title: Question 2.8 — (T.
exact_target: Can finite-type invariants approximate finite-group representation counts of knot groups, and the analogous finite-quandle coloring counts; if not, can they still provide information about those counts?

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400030 (AMR-103-0030). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 2.8 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
